summary.name: rewrite.ai
summary.one_liner: rewrite.ai is a domain name listed for sale at a full price of $94,900 through Spaceship, offered with a lease-to-own payment plan.
use_cases: find domain sale listings on Spaceship
summary.what_it_does: The page is a sale listing for the rewrite.ai domain name, not a working software tool. It states a full price of $94,900 and a lease-to-own structure: a $30,000 first payment, 18 future monthly payments of $3,416.66, and a $3,400 final payment. The buyer can use the domain right away and gets full ownership once everything is paid. The listing says the purchase is completed on spaceship.com, with free transaction support and secure payments. The page text does not describe any site content or features behind the domain. The directory entry describes an AI Rewriter for anti-plagiarism and anti-AIGC trace removal, but that is a separate listing and this page does not confirm it.
notable: Lease-to-own: use the domain immediately, full ownership after full payment
Full price listed at $94,900 with $30,000 first payment
Checkout and transfer handled through Spaceship
caveats: Costs $94,900 in total, with payments spread over 18 months
The page does not describe any software or service running on the domain
Completing the purchase requires redirection to spaceship.com
